peer_carmy_ptr_hyp.note: Aliased triple (+0x108/+0x130/+0x190) forms one-way peer chains among HAI armies, often terminating at country_tag=16 (DOM neighbor) or null. Not bidirectional; not owner_match; not a theatre army list. Observe-only.

locality_2de.note: 10/17 HAI peer targets share theatre and sit in TH_ARMIES; still one-way (0 bidir); 0 front-overlap via controller province sets while paused. Locality strengthened; not promoted past hypothesis.

theatre_ptr.note: Per-object field; not a multi-slot base.

controller_area_ptr.note: Per-object field; not a multi-slot base.

object_stride_packed.note: Heap often packs CFront objects contiguously at stride 0x90.

slot_array.note: 2cy-2da 'slot k' reads were the theatre/controller of the packed neighbor CFront at F+k*0x90, not fields of a single object. Do not use multi-slot formula.

field_map_cfront.hai_theatre_fronts_any_slot_note: Prior any-slot counts (30/44/60/92) inflated by walking packed neighbors; correct HAI front count via theatre@+0x18 is 6.

kind_u32_8.note: Constant 0x42 on every CFront — type/kind/header discriminator.

front_id_u32_c.note: u32@+0xc unique across all fronts — front serial/id. In packed 0x90 runs, successive ids often differ by small positives (not strictly +1). Not a multi-slot index.

intra_object_rtti_ptrs.note: Within object span [0..0x90): only CTheatre*@+0x18 and CControllerArea*@+0x70 classify as known RTTI ptrs. Confirms packed stride model — no hidden multi-slot theatre/controller fields.

hai_front_army_link.path: CFront+0x18 -> CTheatre+0x68 -> CArmy*[]  AND  CArmy+0x2a0 -> CTheatre
hai_front_army_link.note: No CArmy* embed inside CFront blob; link is theatre-mediated. TH_FRONTS lists the 6 HAI fronts; TH_ARMIES lists all 17 HAI armies on that theatre.

packed_run_theatre_mix.note: Packed 0x90 runs mix many theatres (e.g. run454 has 41 unique) — allocator adjacency, not ownership grouping.

extended_beyond_0x90.evidence: Mid/first-in-run show CProvince*/CFrontSection* CPdxArrays at those offs only because +0x90 neighbor CFront exists; last-in-run (no +0x90 CFront) yields garbage sizes/caps. Same failure mode as multi-slot reject (2db).

embedded_parent_slot_theatre_ptrs.note: See embedded_theatre_ptrs; multi-slot parent indexing withdrawn.

embedded_theatre_ptrs.note: Stable CTheatre* embeds remain @+0x28/+0x40/+0x58 (+0x70 repeats). With multi-slot REJECTED: these match theatres of packed-run CFront neighbors relative to parent, not slots of one parent object. parent+0x18 match at +0x28 was 0 this session.

army_embed_scan_2de.note: HAI-front FS and their SPerCountrySection embed 0 HAI CArmy* in first 0x200.

country_tag.note: u32@+0x8; HAI tag=15 on 8 sampled sections

inline_carmy_ptrs.note: CArmy* appear at variable offs inside HAI sections (no stable single field / no begin-end vector proven); treat as observe-only.

country_tag_u32_8.note: u32@+0x8 == 15 on 8 SPer linked from HAI fronts (and 8 heap-wide with tag 15).

province_id_range_hyp_20_34.note: u32 cells often look like province ids (<30k) but 0 overlap with current HAI army province_ids this session — weak, do not promote.
